project_name: A Bayesian Approach to Predict Solubility Parameters
summary: Solubility governs behavior across pharmaceuticals, coatings, organic semiconductors and chemical synthesis, but resists prediction because of the interplay between solute and solvent. This project set out to model Hansen solubility parameters with Gaussian-process regression trained on chemical descriptors and sigma profiles, taking an existing Bayesian treatment of the problem as both benchmark and dataset\cite{sanchez-lengeling_bayesian_2018} and using the then newly released GAUCHE framework\cite{griffiths_gauche_2024} to compare its molecular kernels, including fingerprint-based ones. The submission remained at the proposal stage: the repository field on the project page was left commented out, and no code, notebook or data associated with the project has been published, so no kernel comparison or predictive results are available and none are reported here. (No recorded video was submitted for this project; this summary was prepared from the team's project page, which is the only public artifact of the project.)
